notes.title: Introducing Elite Items
notes.content:
[table][tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33422551/d44c76bfab7af3b0ef0d58688b3e292798da7098.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33422551/80a85bed855e2a17f7a80ccd3b7276a5e45cf498.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Lucky adventurers will find 6 new elite items in place of normal armor or weapons.

"[b]Elite[/b]" Equipment
[list]
[*] Whenever a chest rolls a weapon or armor, there is an 8% chance of an Elite item showing up instead.
[*] Elite items have their own models within chests.
[*] Elite Armor have 25 more life than the best normal armor.
[*] Elite Weapons have 2 dps more than the best normal weapon.
[*] All Elite items have a special attribute.
[*] Upgrading an Elite item does not remove its special attribute.
[*] Elite items do not need to be unlocked.
[*] It is possible to roll Elite items in town.
[/list]

List of Six New Elite Items
[list]
[*] Eternal Flame: 32 DPS, Seeks Targets
[*] Hell-Forged: 250 Life, Immolation
[*] Legion Plate: 250 Life, Summons Legionnaire
[*] God Hammer: 32 DPS, Knockback
[*] Toxic Trident: 32 DPS, Poisons
[*] Frost Guard: 250 Life, Freezes on Touch
[/list]

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NThERTU

notes.title: [New Patch is LIVE] Inferno Ring, Bonus Heart and Punchy Prefix Added
notes.content:
== New Items ==
Unlock the Inferno Ring and Bonus Heart at 25 and 30 repeat boss kills.

Inferno Ring
Creates a zone which grants bonus damage to your attacks while you or your allies stand in it.

Bonus Heart
Adds 50 bonus life to your health pool. This extra life drains by 1 per second. You cannot have more than 50 bonus life at a time and appears as a blue heart to the right of your other hearts.

== New Prefix ==

Punchy is now available for all players. For each item with Punchy equipped you will have a whopping 15% chance on hit to knock back your opponent a short distance.

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NThERTU

notes.title: Update and Suggestions Needed!
notes.content:
- Bug Update -
Players should now properly leave lobbies upon quitting a game. If you see "player quit" repeatedly or cannot damage enemies in a multiplayer game please let me know. This was a rare and difficult to reproduce bug that is hopefully gone now.

- Chest Drops from Bosses -
Bosses now give you 1-9 chests. Enjoy!

- Content Update Suggestions -
Please let me know on the forums what you'd like added to the game for additional content. I am exploring several possibilities but your input is always welcome!

notes.title: "Shocking" Patch 1/11/2019
notes.content:
-= New Prefix =-
A "Shocking" new prefix has been added to the game. It has a 33% chance to fire off a bolt of lightning when striking enemies. High damage but random patterns of attack.

-= New Item =-
Chaotic Bolts can now be unlocked for 20 repetetive boss kills. 8 second cooldown to fire two bolts of lightning that move in a consistent pattern.

-= FOV Option Added =-
You can now set the field of view (degrees) your character can see around them, from 45 default to 120.

-= Nerfed Proc'ing Prefixes =-
Prefixes that spawn bullets such as Shocking, Pyro and Homing no longer can proc off themselves. Sorry this was just way too OP, especially with Pyro.

notes.content:

Wizard's Heart
Shoot a wave of bullets that heal you for the damage they deal to enemies.

notes.content:
What's New
=========
4 new enemies
4 new randomized levels
4 new bosses
6 new earnable items

Tweaks

Damage and reload times tweaked for most magical on use items.
Apprentice wand now always shoots daggers.

notes.title: Post Launch Patch (9/2/2018)
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
=========
Teleporting in boss rooms will no longer send you outside of the level.
Magma Scale and Goblin Crown now look correct in multiplayer.

Updates
=========
Blood now spreads out on the ground and looks much cooler.
New Achievement: Frost Blade drops after the second time you kill the same boss.
New Upgrades allow you to decide which equipment is upgraded instead of always being random.
Bones and Guts from kills are now larger models.

What's Coming Next
==================
I am working on the third area of the game, Hell. This will come with 4 new bosses, 4 new enemies, potions, magic items and weapon prefixes.

If you have any ideas for game updates, achivement ideas, etc please let me know!
